design.dev_set_separation: Held out from the 30-email development set; do not tune prompt/pipeline on this benchmark before final scoring.
design.category_policy: Gold categories use preferred + acceptable to tolerate taxonomy ambiguity.
design.context_policy: Context-dependent events keep raw_text but normalized=null and depends_on_context=true.
design.risk_policy: Action/reply/deadline misses are weighted more heavily than false-positive reminders.
